2609.37582.title: FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
2609.37582.paper_summary: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.
2609.37582.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦知識必須能夠被具有不同模式、私有架構和任務的接收者所使用。<lb/>我們提出了 FedSocket，它使接收者執行成為交換模型的設計要求。<lb/>一個共享的 Q 結合了接收者可計算的輸入、任務擁有的輸出和擁有權感知的聚合，通過一個共同的預測介面連接異質的私有模型。<lb/>私有模型教導本地 Q 副本；返回的 Q 支持本地學習和聯合推斷，僅交換 Q 參數和計數。<lb/>在六個數據集上，FedSocket 在 MELD 和 UCF-51 上分別提高了缺失模式接收者的準確度 14.44 和 15.51 個百分點。<lb/>在匹配的推斷能力下，聯合推斷在 UCF-51 準確度上超過獨立集成 11.06 個百分點，在雙向 Flickr30k R@1 上超過 4.87 個百分點。<lb/>聯合推斷在所有四個異質端點上也優於僅使用 Q，顯示出結合本地和交換預測的價值。<lb/>教師控制、共享路徑干預和組件因子識別了監督、共享和部署的角色。<lb/>FedSocket 使得從聯邦訓練到接收者推斷的交換知識可以直接使用。
